archetypes.name: dyn-auth-boundary
archetypes.rationale: new auth gate touches session-env, issue-create, oos-filer, audit-runs, design-terminal and dedup paths
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new check_live_mutation_auth function in python/larch/state/session_env.py and its callers: issue_create.py, oos_filer.py, audit_runs.py, _report.py, design_terminal.py. Verify operator_mode bypasses test-deny correctly, session roots are validated, symlinks are rejected, and the test conftest autouse fixture properly blocks session-inherited auth without blocking operator-invoked calls. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
